description: mod-gobi configuration template. Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-gobi revision 15, image 3.1.1); see ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. mod-gobi is a RAML Module Builder (Vert.x) module: it reads its database settings from DB_* variables, has no Kafka and no secret store, and takes its HTTP port from the http.port system property in JAVA_OPTIONS. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-gobi container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-gobi container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-gobi container in MiB

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size. Value taken from bugfest; with MaxMetaspaceSize it leaves about 128 MiB of the container for non-heap memory

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size. Value taken from bugfest

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Threshold for the first metaspace garbage collection, not a limit. Value taken from bugfest

deployment.description: mod-gobi is stateless apart from custom mappings stored in PostgreSQL; it has no Kafka listeners or scheduled jobs, so replicas can run side by side without coordination.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient: each GOBI order request creates one purchase order with a bounded number of lookups in other modules.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL host (write instance)

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL username, usually supplied from the secret store

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL password, usually supplied from the secret store

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER
EnvVars.description: Optional synchronously replicated read instance host; reads go to DB_HOST when unset

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER
EnvVars.description: Port of the read instance; reads go to DB_HOST when unset

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: PEM certificate(s) to validate the PostgreSQL server; when set, TLSv1.3 is required

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per tenant per instance. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 4

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per instance shared by all tenants; when set, DB_MAXPOOLSIZE is ignored

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Idle time in milliseconds after which a connection is closed (RMB default); 0 keeps idle connections open

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum connection lifetime in milliseconds (RMB default); 0 means unlimited

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of retries after a failed database connect; reconnecting is disabled when unset

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Delay in milliseconds between reconnect attempts

EnvVars.name: DB_EXPLAIN_QUERY_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Query duration in milliseconds above which RMB logs EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 1000

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the module process. -Dhttp.port=8082 moves RMB off its default port 8081, which the Eureka sidecar uses; it must match the sidecar's MODULE_URL. Heap sizing comes from the java block.

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: External Log4j2 configuration overriding the bundled log4j2.properties (log4j2-json.properties is also bundled)

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the sidecar container in MiB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier; must match the other modules and sidecars

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the sidecar process, including the sizing from the java block

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL of the mod-gobi container; the port must match -Dhttp.port

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-gobi module deployed alongside this sidecar
